_comment: What loudr-1-turbo is made of. Consumed by tools/pack_turbo.py:
Paths are relative to --root, which is the research tree on the machine that
holds the training checkpoints. The sha256s are the contract: a file that no
longer hashes to what is written here stops the build rather than quietly
producing a different model under the same name.
name: loudkit-v0.1-turbo
_n_cfm_timesteps_note: The estimator below was step-distilled 6 -> 1: it reproduces a six-step
stock rollout in one Euler step (dev-seen mel median 0.9973, unseen 0.9956,
against 0.9699 for the same weights simply run at K=1). Running it at any
other K is a different algorithm, which is why this number ships beside the
weights instead of being a runtime flag.

t3._note: fusion student after on-policy KD x H7 — the round that fixed the tempo

s3gen._note: stock renderer; only the flow estimator is replaced below

estimator._note: step-distilled 6 -> 1, EMA half; ckpt_s3gen_k1_full is the same recipe against a two-step teacher and is NOT this file
